The artist

My story

Music has been part of my life since childhood. It began as something I shared with my brother, and over time, it became a way for me to understand emotions, tell stories, and connect with people.

Life took us through different places and experiences, but music remained a common thread between us. That shared history continues to inspire Circuit, our musical project, and the creative direction we want to explore together.

“I don’t want to be limited to a single sound; I want every performance to have its own character.”

I am building my journey as an independent artist, one performance, one collaboration, and one creation at a time. This website is a window into that journey — the music I make, the things I create, the people who inspire me, and the places I hope to reach.

Sreeharsh S Prasad

Short biography

Sreeharsh S Prasad is an independent vocalist and visual artist, and a student at IIT Guwahati. Drawn to different genres and the freedom to experiment, he shapes each performance with its own character. He is part of Circuit, a musical project he shares with his brother.

Full biography

Sreeharsh S Prasad is an independent vocalist whose relationship with music began in childhood, as something shared with his brother. Over time it became his way of understanding emotions, telling stories and connecting with people.

That shared history continues in Circuit, the musical project he and his brother have built together, and in the creative direction they want to explore.

As a vocalist he is drawn to different genres and values the freedom to experiment, and aims for every performance to have its own character rather than a single, fixed sound.

Outside music, he paints, designs, experiments with visual storytelling and makes things with his own hands. These practices inform one another and shape how he approaches creative work.

He is building his career as an independent artist while studying at IIT Guwahati — one performance, one collaboration and one creation at a time. His live repertoire, performed at IIT Guwahati, includes Mithwa, Jee Loon Zaara, Boat Song, Teri Deewani, and Navarasam and Siva by Thaikkudam Bridge. He also performs solo with karaoke, including Velmurugan, Thankinakka Thillam and Madhura Kinnavin. His first original song is on the way.
